item.text: {"paper_id":"paper164","profile_id":"neuroscience","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"We evaluated the association between baseline serum brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) and 1-year screening-defined incident cognitive impairment and examined whether BDNF added predictive information beyond routine clinical, laboratory, and baseline cognitive variables.","rationale":"The study directly addresses cognition and a potential biomarker for incident cognitive impairment in hemodialysis patients, matching the profile’s interests in cognition and neurological biomarkers.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
